Get involved

Request an announcement

Running a fundraiser, a signing day, a club meeting seniors should know about? Tell us and we will get it on the news page.

Who you are

Not published. We use it to check details with you.

The announcement

Plain and specific beats clever. We may tighten it.

Include dates and times exactly as you have them. If a date is not confirmed, say so and we will label it that way.

Timing and extras

When it needs to be live.

Sign-up form, official page, ticket link.

A flyer or photo, up to 10MB.

Nothing posts automatically.

How this works

  • An editor reads every request. We post things that are relevant to seniors, from a real person, and true as far as we can tell.
  • School dates are checked against the WHS site or district calendar first. Unconfirmed dates get a Tentative label rather than being left out.
  • We might edit for length and clarity. We will not change the facts without asking you.
  • Ads, personal fundraisers not tied to a WHS group, and anything that names a student negatively will not be posted.

Teachers and sponsors: if you already post to the official WHS site, send us the link and we will point to it instead.
